required_outcomes: Recognises R-4809 is a duplicate of R-4801 created by the portal intake, for the same tap.
Keeps one job and one contractor, and cancels or stands down the other job and tells that contractor.
Gives the tenant one clear date and contractor.
Records why the duplicate was closed on the job it keeps.
acceptable_alternatives: Keeping the earlier Monday slot (R-4809) and cancelling Thursday instead, if the reason is recorded and Swift is told.
positive_behaviours: Checks the tenant can do the slot that stands.
Flags the intake duplication so it does not recur.
red_flags: Escalating a routine clean-up to a human.
prohibited_actions: Opening a third job or assigning a third contractor.
critical_failures: Leaves both contractors booked to attend the same tap.
